items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He hired me. And I didn't know anything about it.

ctx.x: And he says, Mama, look, here's a block at the top. He's playing with it.

Yeah. I was going to ask about Orey. Some of the older people from New Orleans used to be very elitist about their music, saying that they knew how to play this better than anybody else. Was he like that?
He hired me. And I didn't know anything about it. I just read what he had to read.
